links.outcome: Under-triage of traumatic hand/wrist injuries by consumer LLM chatbots
links.effect: Overall triage accuracy 83.3%, with 1.3% over-triage and 15.3% under-triage; under-triage 0.0% minor, 16.7% elective, 21.7% trauma (P = .0348).
links.quote: Under-triage increased with acuity: 0.0% for minor injuries, 16.7% for elective presentations, and 21.7% for trauma (P = .0348).

links.outcome: Missed or inadequate escalation (under-triage) of time-critical injuries by LLMs
links.effect: 15.3% under-triage overall, rising to 21.7% for trauma vignettes; 1.3% over-triage.
links.quote: Overall triage accuracy was 83.3%, with 1.3% over-triage and 15.3% under-triage.

screen.reason: Evaluates diagnostic and triage accuracy of consumer LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot) using standardized patient-voice clinical vignettes for hand and wrist complaints without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
